title: %coalesce - first non-null value
purpose: Return the first argument that is not null.
notes: Arguments are tried left-to-right; the first non-null wins (here nickname is ~, so firstName is used).
End with a quoted literal default so the result is never null.
Only null (~) is skipped; empty strings are kept (use %ifEmpty to treat an empty string as missing).

avoid.why: with no literal fallback the result is ~ when every field is null
